recon.notes: Linktree is a Next.js page whose link list is fully present in static HTML (__NEXT_DATA__), confirmed by parsing it. The one event lead points at The Tavern Group's in-house ticketing SPA (tickets.taverngroupevents.com, Express/Fly.io); its working data door is GET /api/public/ticket-events/<slug>, which returns ISO instants with the year. Local wall-clock: 2026-10-31T01:00Z = Friday 2026-10-30 21:00 EDT (DST still in force on Oct 30; ends Nov 1). The rendered page shows this as "Fri, Oct 30, 9:00 PM" in America/New_York but "Sat, Oct 31, 2:00 AM" in the recon Mac's Europe/Madrid zone — the ticket page never prints a year or a timezone. The Linktree's own label "10/30" agrees with the ET reading. Raw artifacts: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-stanleyrya-workspace-chunky-dad/49179ac5-44be-4797-821c-ffb35abc0b2d/scratchpad/recon/cubhouse/.

coverage.basis: Door 1 (Linktree, 16 links): 1 ticket link + 15 galleries → 1 event lead. Door 2 (public ticket-events JSON for that slug): recurring.occurrences has exactly 1 entry and relatedEvents is empty → 1 published upcoming event; the rendered page's "Event Date" picker has the same single option. Door 3 (the unauthenticated internal /api/events ops calendar, 1393 rows): 3 Cubhouse rows — the same 2026-10-30 event, one past 2026-08-28 party (counted as a past listing only — and corroborated by the "8/28 PHOTOS" gallery), and one 2026-12-18 row in status IDEA with no public slug, which is an unpublished internal plan, not a published event (recorded as a trap). Delta between doors fully explained: 1 published. Past listings: the Linktree carries 15 gallery links for 8 past parties (3/29, 5/30, 8/29, 10/31, 2/13, 4/10, 6/05, 8/28 — no years printed), counted not enumerated. No flyer image exists on any door (the only image is the 254 venue logo). No public list endpoint exists on the ticket platform (404).

events.title: Halloween Cubhouse
events.note: Feed: start_at "2026-10-31 01:00:00+00", end_at "2026-10-31 06:00:00+00" (year comes from the feed; the ticket PAGE prints no year). Local wall-clock recorded = 2026-10-30 21:00–02:00 EDT, which is what the page renders for an ET viewer ("Fri, Oct 30, 9:00 PM", "Sales close Sat, Oct 31, 2:00 AM") and what the Linktree link label says ("10/30 TICKETS 🐻🎃"). Marked ambiguous ONLY because the site never states a timezone: the same page rendered in the recon Mac's Europe/Madrid zone reads "Sat, Oct 31, 2:00 AM" and "Sales close Sat, Oct 31, 7:00 AM" — a crawler that trusts the rendered text in a non-ET zone will date this Oct 31 (see trap halloween-cubhouse-oct-31-2am-rollover). Ticket tag "Body Positive" is shown above the title but is not part of it (feed assets_json.ticketTags). Cover: General Admission $30.00 ("353 remaining"); Tonight Only $15 and Advance $25 are both "Sold out". description_public is null; the on-page prose ("No matter who you are, you are welcome … 254 is a queer space …") is the venue's house text. Space: "254 · Dance Floor". Payment note says "This event is produced by SRE Marketing"; contact Carlton@thetaverngroup.com. Feed says isRecurring: true but lists only this one occurrence, so it is documented as a single.

traps.why: Every one of these is a Pixieset photo gallery of a party that already happened (the Linktree captions each "Photo collection by Cubhouse"; 3/29 is password-gated). They carry a month/day and no year and look like dated event rows, but they are archives, not upcoming events — 8 past parties (3/29, 5/30, 8/29, 10/31, 2/13, 4/10, 6/05, 8/28), two galleries each. Pixieset itself is behind a Cloudflare JS challenge (403 to curl). None of these should become an event record; the internal ops calendar confirms the 8/28 one as 2026-08-29T01:00Z (past).

traps.label: tickets.taverngroupevents.com/halloween-cubhouse-cc3842e7 as fetched without JavaScript — <title>The Tavern Group Events Calendar</title> + empty <div id="root">
traps.why: The ticket page is a 419-byte Vite SPA shell; all event text (title, date, venue, tiers) arrives from GET /api/public/ticket-events/<slug> at runtime. A static crawl reaches the page (the 2026-09-07 page cache holds exactly this shell for this URL, and the 2026-09-09 run produced 0 events in 18 ms) and finds nothing to extract. Not an event, and not a reason to record 'publishes nothing' — the JSON door one hop away has the event.

traps.label: "Sat, Oct 31, 2:00 AM" — the same Halloween Cubhouse rendered in a non-Eastern browser zone
traps.why: The ticket page formats start_at in the viewer's zone with no timezone label and no year. Rendered from a Europe/Madrid machine it reads "Sat, Oct 31, 2:00 AM" (and "Sales close Sat, Oct 31, 7:00 AM"); rendered in America/New_York the identical DOM reads "Fri, Oct 30, 9:00 PM". Both strings are one instant, 2026-10-31T01:00Z. A record dated 2026-10-31 at 02:00 would be the same event mis-dated, not a second event — it must fold into halloween-cubhouse-2026-10-30.

traps.label: "Tonight Only" / "Advance" / "General Admission" rows under "Choose Tickets"
traps.why: Three ticket types for the one event, each with its own price, description and sales window (Tonight Only: "This ticket is only for purchase at the previous Cubhouse event", closed 2026-08-29; Advance: "Presale tickets", sold out; General Admission $30.00, sales close 2026-10-31 06:00Z). "Tonight Only" in particular reads like a separate same-day event and references the PREVIOUS party. They are price tiers of halloween-cubhouse-2026-10-30, never events.

traps.label: Internal /api/events rows: "Cubhouse" 2026-12-19T02:00Z status IDEA (Fri Dec 18 9 PM ET) and "Cubhouse" 2026-08-29T01:00Z (past Aug 28 party)
traps.why: GET /api/events on the ticket platform is the venue group's private ops calendar (1393 rows of IDEA/PENDING/BOOKED plans for all Tavern Group venues) served without authentication. It is not linked from the Linktree or the ticket page and is outside the parser's crawl. The Dec 18 row is status IDEA with no public slug, no ticket page and no public announcement — an internal tentative plan, not a published event; the Aug 28 row is already past. Neither should be extracted from this source; if the Dec 18 date is later published it will appear as a new Linktree ticket link.

traps.label: https://tickets.taverngroupevents.com/ — "Event Calendar / Sign in to your account / Username / PIN"
traps.why: The ticket platform's root (and its /calendar, /events routes in the bundle) is a staff login for The Tavern Group's back office, not a public listing. A crawler climbing from the event slug to the host root finds a sign-in form, not more events; there is also no public list endpoint (/api/public/ticket-events → 404).

openQuestions.q: The crawl already reaches the ticket page (page cache 2026-09-07) but receives the 419-byte SPA shell. The event is only available from GET /api/public/ticket-events/<slug> (unauthenticated JSON with ISO instants) or a rendered DOM. Should the parser learn the tickets.taverngroupevents.com JSON door (slug → /api/public/ticket-events/<slug>) the way it learns other ticketing platforms' APIs?

Timezone rollover: the ticket page prints no year and no timezone; the displayed date depends on the renderer's zone (Oct 30 9 PM in ET, Oct 31 2 AM in CEST). If the scraper ever renders this page, which zone does its WebView use, and does it prefer the feed's +00 instant over the rendered text?
The Linktree has no Instagram/social links (socialLinks: []). Cubhouse's Instagram, if any, was not discoverable from the configured source and was not searched for outside it.
